about:
Sun Solar LLC was founded in 2012 by Caleb Arthur in Houston, Missouri, before moving its headquarters to Springfield, Missouri. Arthur, a former law enforcement officer, turned to solar after a career-ending injury, initially installing a ground-mount system on his own property and then selling and installing systems door-to-door. The company now serves Missouri, Kansas, and Illinois from its Springfield base.

The company provides turnkey solar installation services for residential and commercial customers, handling design, permitting, coordination, installation, electrification, and ongoing service. Its offerings include rooftop and ground-mount solar arrays, Tesla Solar Roof installations (the first in Missouri), and Tesla Powerwall battery backup systems. A dedicated Smart Energy Solutions division adds energy-efficiency upgrades such as LED lighting, attic sealing, and insulation. Financing options span loans, cash purchases, and power purchase agreements.

Sun Solar works primarily with homeowners and businesses across the three-state region. Residential clients include individual households seeking energy independence, while commercial customers range from small businesses to larger facilities such as the Denton Embassy Suites. The company also partners with Everbright Exteriors for roofing services.

Arthur’s “reduce before you produce” philosophy drives the firm’s focus on energy efficiency alongside solar generation, aiming to lower both utility bills and environmental impact. The company emphasizes in-house installation crews and a single-point-of-contact model to streamline the customer experience.
